title: Add executable feature samples and sample integration coverage
objective: Add a provider-free executable sample set under samples/ that documents and exercises the repository's public CLI, library, structured-output, tool-calling, provider, observability, cancellation, and unified-provider features, plus one integration test that discovers and validates every sample.

branch.name: wi-0006-executable-feature-samples
branch.rationale: The work item is prepared on the current repository branch; the branch name records the intended samples and integration-test boundary without requiring a topic branch.

request.text:
Review the set of features in this repository. Prepare a .docs/work-items/* to add a set of samples to be written under samples/* as executable scripts that document and exercise features. provide an integration test that runs and validates all of the samples.

Commit the work item.

scope.name: executable-feature-samples
scope.description: Add a provider-free set of executable native-ESM samples under samples/ covering CLI help/version, v1 raw and structured completion, v2 manual and automatic tools/results, finish_reason normalization, DebugSink lifecycle events, cooperative cancellation, and the unified raw provider interface.
scope.reason: The repository has extensive functionality but no executable examples that show consumers how to use the public package without credentials or real external side effects.

scope.name: sample-integration-harness
scope.description: Add one integration test that discovers every samples/*.mjs script, runs each in a child process after build, validates its JSON result envelope and declared feature assertions, and fails when a sample is missing, non-executable, noisy, or unsuccessful.
scope.reason: A discovery-based harness prevents new samples from becoming untested documentation and verifies the complete sample set consistently.

nonGoals.name: live-provider-execution
nonGoals.description: Do not require API credentials, authenticated provider calls, OpenRouter availability, or network access for any sample or the integration test.
nonGoals.reason: Samples must be deterministic and safe to run in local development and CI.

nonGoals.name: real-external-side-effects
nonGoals.description: Do not invoke shell commands, arbitrary modules, real external tools, persistent services, or real filesystem/network side effects beyond temporary test fixtures.
nonGoals.reason: Samples exercise injected providers, mocked transport, in-memory tools, and temporary bounded fixtures only.

nonGoals.name: contract-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not change llm/request/v1, llm/response/v1, or unrelated request-schema worktree edits as part of the sample addition.
nonGoals.reason: The sample set documents existing behavior and is not a public contract redesign.

nonGoals.name: downstream-runtime-integration
nonGoals.description: Do not add LangGraph, graph scheduling, persistence, checkpointing, deployment, registry publication, or downstream application integration.
nonGoals.reason: Samples are package-local documentation and executable acceptance examples.

items.name: feature-coverage-samples
items.description: The sample set covers the repository's principal provider-free public features with focused executable scripts under samples/.
items.reason: Consumers need runnable examples rather than only prose or unit-test fixtures.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The repository contains executable .mjs samples covering CLI help/version, v1 raw and structured output, v2 manual tools, v2 automatic tool results, finish_reason provider mapping, DebugSink lifecycle events, cooperative cancellation, and unified LlmProvider.complete usage.

items.name: sample-output-protocol
items.description: Every sample follows one deterministic machine-readable execution protocol suitable for discovery and validation.
items.reason: The integration test needs a stable contract independent of sample-specific implementation details.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each sample is directly executable with Node.js from the repository root, exits zero on success, writes exactly one parseable JSON result envelope to stdout, keeps diagnostics off stdout, and includes a stable sample identifier plus feature assertions.

items.name: discovery-integration-test
items.description: One integration test discovers and executes the complete samples/*.mjs set rather than maintaining a manually duplicated sample list.
items.reason: Discovery ensures every newly added sample is exercised automatically.

acceptanceCriteria.description: tests/samples.test.ts discovers sorted samples/*.mjs files, asserts the set is non-empty, runs every script in a child process after build, validates exit code/stdout JSON/stable result fields, and fails if any sample is skipped or invalid.

items.name: safe-provider-free-execution
items.description: Samples and the harness remain deterministic, provider-free, bounded, and compatible with the existing package commands and contracts.
items.reason: Executable documentation must be safe to run in CI and by users without credentials or external side effects.

acceptanceCriteria.description: npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build, and the sample integration pass; v1 regression tests remain green; no network credential dependency, LangGraph dependency, real tool execution, or unrelated request-schema change is introduced.
